gen-fs-bespoke-slab-satoshi: Bespoke Slab carries a high-set midline that gives its headings a bookish, upright dignity. Satoshi counters with a soaring x-height and a wide-open e, every stroke cut to one width, which is the pair's real charm.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-switzer: Bespoke Slab sits its midline high, giving each heading a dignified, bookish lift. Switzer follows in tubular, wire-like strokes with a tall waist line, so a long passage moves along smoothly, never cramped.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-work-sans: Work Sans reads modern and flat-lined, its mean line set high and its c tips held well apart. Bespoke Slab, with its high midline and low stroke contrast, adds a bookish, dignified voice over it.
gen-fs-bonny-gf-science-gothic: Literary and refined, Bonny tightens its lines and lets curves gape. Science Gothic does the opposite job, spacing stroke ends far apart so each letter reads singly, with no thick or thin anywhere.
gen-fs-bonny-gf-syncopate: Bonny's arches thin slightly as they leave the stem. Syncopate sets neon-tube letters beneath, glowing in one steady line, and the spacing like rungs on a rope ladder gives a sharp, technical counterpoint.
gen-fs-chubbo-bitter: Chubbo draws each bend smooth and unobstructed, like a marker tip gliding. Bitter takes over with a very large lowercase eye and a visible gap in each s, so give it a generous size.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary and dignified, its tall middle band tucked between shallow ascenders and descenders. Chubbo hums softly beside it, casual and inviting, so the two feel like a handshake after a formal introduction.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-glegoo: Refined and editorial, the text here comes with big counters and curves that stay wide open. Glegoo stands taller in the lowercase than Chubbo, whose marker-tip roundness feels more casual and inviting beside it.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-hanuman: Traditional and refined, Hanuman holds a high-waisted lowercase with wide-set terminals on its s. And Chubbo, casual and inviting with its marker-tip curves, earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-kadwa: Classic and editorial, Kadwa runs open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height. But Chubbo does the friendlier work, its round letters having rims that match the stems, while Kadwa carries the text.
